items.title: Alphabet Seeks $3.6 Billion in First Australian Bond Sale
items.description: Alphabet is looking to raise about A$5 billion ($3.6 billion) in what would be its debut bond offering in Australia, people familiar with the matter said, as US tech firms binge on debt to fuel AI spending. Bloomberg Tech's Ed Ludlow joins to discuss this as well as the latest from Anthropic.

items.title: AI hyperscalers or memory chips: Which is the better investment right now?
items.description: While Micron Technology (MU) and Sandisk (SNDK) stock both get a lift Monday morning, Zacks Investment Research stock strategist Ethan Feller takes a closer look at whether memory chipmakers or AI hyperscalers are the better investment in this market environment.

items.title: Alphabet Eyes $3.6 Billion in First Australian Bond Sale
items.description: Alphabet is looking to raise about $3.6 billion in what would be its debut bond offering in Australia, according to people familiar with the matter. Initial price guidance on the deal may be provided as early as Tuesday, with the notes potentially pricing the following day. Mandeep Singh of Bloomber

items.title: California billionaires pour $40 million into blocking wealth tax
items.description: Google cofounder Sergey Brin is among California's wealthiest residents who are fighting to block a proposed billionaire tax. Proposition 40 would impose a one-time 5% tax on California residents with more than $1 billion in assets to increase healthcare funding in the state.

items.title: OpenAI releases new ChatGPT for Teens with parental controls, guardrails
items.description: OpenAI (OPAI.PVT) released a new version of ChatGPT with updated parental controls and safety guardrails for teenage users. Yahoo Finance Tech Editor Dan Howley outlines the growing safety concerns around AI and the features of this new AI model.

items.title: SpaceX shareholders include Google, Nvidia, BlackRock: Tracking the stock's volatility
items.description: A 13F filing has uncovered notable corporate ownership of SpaceX (SPCX) shares. Yahoo Finance Markets and Data Editor Jared Blikre takes a closer look at SpaceX's shareholder makeup and stock volatility since the IPO.

items.title: There's 'light at the end of the tunnel' for tech stocks amid bond rout: Eric Jackson
items.description: As bond yields (^TYX, ^TNX, ^FVX) continue to surge ahead, EMJ Capital founder and president Eric Jackson and Yahoo Finance Markets and Data Editor Jared Blikre outline the impact this is having on Big Tech stocks and AI hyperscalers.
